description: Restart of exp514 (tied LUT unembedder) after its aux/tie froze (aux_ce stuck ~10.40, aux_top1 ~0 through step 600). Diagnosis: tie LRs far below the validated tied_lut_inverse_test.py recipe (tok_emb_lr=unemb_lr=1e-2, no warmup) PLUS the L2-normalize attenuated the embedding gradient ~4x. Fixes here: (a) tok_emb_lr=unemb_lr=1e-2, (b) NO WARMUP on the tok_emb+unemb groups (constant->cosine, like the test's constant LR), (c) dropped the L2-normalize in the unembedder forward. Body LUTs keep lut_lr=1e-3/adam_lr=3e-4 with warmup. Goal: get aux_top1 (embedding self-decode) to climb toward ~99% INSIDE the model so the main LM loss can ride on the tie. Same architecture as exp514 (E=64 dual stream collapsed, RowTokenLUT nap=15/tph=16, main+aux CE + assignment STE).
